camera_changes.installed_by: easy/post_setup.py (VERSION 2) over SSH: --check listed only these 2 files, --reboot wrote them and rebooted, --check afterwards: nothing to change
camera_changes.majestic_yaml: not changed (audio.enabled: true had been set by the owner)

findings.symptom: microphone noisy in WebRTC, RTSP, /video.mp4, /audio.opus and /audio.m4a; /audio.pcm and /audio.alaw sound right

cause.summary: majestic gives the AI driver u32ChnCnt 2 and then builds its own audio pipeline with the same 2 channels, but feeds it only the mono AI channel 0; Opus and AAC take the mono samples as interleaved stereo
cause.init_audio_in: 0x78dd8: AIO_ATTR_S on the stack, u32ChnCnt = 2 (mov r4, #2 at 0x78e28), rebuilt on every audio start
cause.pipeline: ldrb r2, [sp, #56] at 0x790a0 hands the same u32ChnCnt to the pipeline created at 0x75730 as its channel count
cause.opus: SILK NB 10 ms stereo packets (TOC config 0, s=1) stamped as 20 ms: players get half of the sound, an octave too high (the room's 90 Hz tone came out at 180 Hz)
cause.aac: stereo, decodes to half the wall-clock length
cause.analog: not the cause: PCM is clean at the default gain (no clipping, no jumps)
cause.sdk: hi_comm_aio.h documents u32ChnCnt as the channel number on the I2S frame, valid 2/4/8/16; 1 was not tried on the driver, which keeps getting 2

stock_firmware.source: cmsMain.out from the stock appfs dump (reverse engineering, not run)
stock_firmware.input: AI channel 0 as mono, like majestic

findings.conclusion: u32ChnCnt 2 is what the stock firmware gives the driver as well; only majestic's reuse of it for the encoders is wrong

fix.library: audio/libmajaudiofix.so, assembled from audio/majaudiofix.S with GNU as/ld 2.40 against the rootfs's musl libc.so; exports only HI_MPI_AI_SetPubAttr, imports only dlsym
fix.logic: calls the real HI_MPI_AI_SetPubAttr (dlsym RTLD_NEXT) with the attributes unchanged; only when it returned 0, enSoundmode is mono and u32ChnCnt is 2, sets the caller's u32ChnCnt to 1, which majestic then uses for its pipeline
fix.driver: still gets u32ChnCnt 2 (/proc/umap/ai: ChnCnt 2, channels 0 and 1 enabled, as before)
fix.start: overlay /etc/init.d/S95majestic adds the library to LD_PRELOAD and execs sh /rom/etc/init.d/S95majestic, so start, stop, restart, reload and the firmware's supervisor stay the firmware's
fix.post_setup: step 6: only over the firmware's S95majestic or an older one of ours; otherwise a note and no change
